text.tspan: Bits and bytes: link speeds are in bits, file sizes in bytes, so divide by 8
(headers and ACKs make it a bit slower)
Trap: network prefixes are decimal (1 Mbit = 1,000,000 bits); some tools use binary units (1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes).
iperf3 prints transfer in binary MBytes and rate in decimal Mbits/sec: about 5% apart at mega, 7% at giga.
The same 8× bit / byte confusion breaks subnetting maths too (2.1).
